digest: Malicious PowerShell executed via WinWord on FIN-DB-02, downloading and executing a payload from 203.0.113.77, followed by persistent command and control (C2) communication. The initial assessment of routine maintenance was incorrect.

evidence_findings.title: Malicious PowerShell Execution
evidence_findings.subject: powershell.exe on FIN-DB-02
evidence_findings.evidence: A PowerShell process (powershell.exe) was launched on FIN-DB-02 by winword.exe with a hidden, encoded command. The decoded command 'IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient)' is used to download and execute remote content.
evidence_findings.conclusion: Unauthorized and malicious code execution occurred on FIN-DB-02.

evidence_findings.title: Unauthorized Activity Confirmed
evidence_findings.subject: Maintenance Team
evidence_findings.evidence: The maintenance team confirmed that no approved changes or administrative activity on FIN-DB-02 involved the observed PowerShell command or the destination IP address 203.0.113.77.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The activity is not legitimate maintenance and is unauthorized.

evidence_findings.title: Remote Payload Download
evidence_findings.subject: hxxps://203.0.113.77/update.dat
evidence_findings.evidence: The decoded PowerShell command was used to download and execute a file named 'update.dat' from the URL hxxps://203.0.113.77/update.dat.
evidence_findings.conclusion: A malicious payload was downloaded from an external, unapproved source.

evidence_findings.title: Persistent Command and Control (C2) Communication
evidence_findings.subject: 10.20.8.42 to 203.0.113.77
evidence_findings.evidence: FIN-DB-02 (10.20.8.42) established 120 periodic connections over 30 seconds to 203.0.113.77 on port 443 immediately after the PowerShell execution. This destination is not on the corporate allowlist.
evidence_findings.conclusion: Persistent outbound communication indicates active command and control or data exfiltration.

attack_chain.description: winword.exe launched powershell.exe, suggesting a document-based attack (e.g., macro, exploit).
Malicious PowerShell command executed to download and run a remote script.
PowerShell command was hidden ('-w hidden') and encoded ('-enc') to evade detection.
Persistent outbound connections to 203.0.113.77 for C2 communication.
Potential for data exfiltration, further system compromise, or lateral movement.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Malicious PowerShell execution and initial C2 communication observed.

ioc_indicators.context: Command and Control server and payload source.
URL for the downloaded malicious payload.
Parent process of malicious PowerShell, indicating initial access vector.

remediations.description: Immediately isolate FIN-DB-02 (10.20.8.42) from the network to prevent further compromise or spread.
Conduct a full forensic analysis of FIN-DB-02 to determine the initial infection vector, full extent of compromise, and any data exfiltration.
Block the malicious IP address 203.0.113.77 at the perimeter firewall and proxy.
Review Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) logs and other security tools for similar activity across the environment.
Reinforce phishing awareness and safe document handling practices, especially regarding unexpected processes launched by common applications like Microsoft Word.

unknowns: The exact initial access vector (e.g., specific phishing email, exploited vulnerability in WinWord).
The full functionality and purpose of the 'update.dat' payload.
The extent of data exfiltration or further compromise on FIN-DB-02.
Whether other systems within the environment are affected by the same threat.
